texts.text: LARA: Honey, don't just be a sack of{br}potatoes!{br}Dance with me!

texts.text: My husband chose the kitchen{br}because he hates fighting.{br}Life has a strange sense of humor.

Farquaad's three lieutenants{br}fled to an island.{full}They have not given up.{br}Please be careful out there.

MISTRESS: And I have plans of my own…{page}Now that the boy's back, it's time to{br}set my sights on his father, hee hee.
